beschreibung:
Research Station in the Prehistoric Realm

On the Steinplatte in Waidring, visitors immerse themselves deeply in Earth's prehistoric past at the Triassic Center. Where mighty limestone rocks tower into the sky today, the subtropical Tethys Ocean was located over 200 million years ago. Vivid exhibits and modern media technology illustrate the evolution of fascinating marine reptiles.

Exciting Discoveries for All Ages

Children can dig for fossils at interactive research stations and examine microscopic marine organisms. The adjoining Triassic Trail leads past life-sized dinosaur replicas and opens up magnificent panoramic views of the Kitzbüheler Alpen.
